item.title: AMS Appoints Sarah Bryant, PhD, as Chief Scientific Advancement Officer
item.description: The American Mathematical Society (AMS) is happy to announce that Sarah Bryant, PhD, has been promoted to the newly created role of Chief Scientific Advancement Officer (CSAO). Previously Associate Vice President for AMS Office of Programs and Professional Services, Bryant brings more than two decades of experience in mathematics research, education, and leadership to the position. item.title: The Mathematical and Statistical Sciences Annual Survey Reopens
item.description: The Mathematical and Statistical Sciences Annual Survey will reopen on November 12, 2025, inviting mathematics and statistics departments across the country to contribute vital data about the health of the discipline. Coordinated by the AMS-ASA-IMS-MAA-SIAM Joint Data Committee and administered by Rankin Climate, LLC, the survey collects information on doctoral recipients, recruitment and hiring, faculty salaries, and departmental characteristics at U.S. institutions. item.title: Taylor to Receive 2026 Steele Prize for Mathematical Exposition
item.description: Michael E. Taylor Michael E. Taylor, William R. Kenan Jr. Professor of Mathematics emeritus, University of North Carolina, is awarded the 2026 Leroy P. Steele Prize for Mathematical Exposition for his fundamental treatise "Partial Differential Equations, Volumes I-III," published in 1996 as volumes 115-117 of Springer Verlag's Applied Mathematical Sciences series.
